Run owns PE reporting; Create/Maintain own selected verifier assets, and standalone Performance owns measurement evidence. Missing local verifier assets do not add generator/maintenance work to a Run. UI Stress exercises worst-case data in isolated temporary fixtures and returns repairs to the executor; it retains its own report unless contributing to Run.

Use reusable app-driving instructions without copying the report engine. Map requested features and entrypoints deliberately into PE feature/list reports, preserve prerequisites and lifecycle-versus-behavior states, reuse evidence, and keep one driver/cleanup owner per shared instance. Creation proves one seeded feature; maintenance accounts for every mapped feature.

Select Interrogate for independent same-intent challenge without automatically adding it to Code review. Keep lead-filtered findings separate from Standards/Spec axes. Honor actual host reviewers and disclose diversity/context gaps; quality blockers require concrete consequences, not a line-count or finding-count heuristic. Review remains read-only.

Impact traces downstream contracts and proves safety facts through existing checks or owned isolated scratch probes. Product edits and external effects require separate authority. Use source/history evidence directly and select bundled Adversarial only when independent challenge is needed; external How/Why/Arena/Unslop installations are not required.

An omitted mode requires a brief How/Why/Teach chooser and a user answer before method loading or investigation. Honor explicit mode choices and reuse them for follow-ups. Teach calls bundled methods directly so internal dispatch does not repeat the chooser.

Standalone Why defaults to its full available evidence-category investigation. Teach may bound Why to its stated question and selected sources; exclusions are recorded as outside scope, distinct from unavailable or searched-empty categories, and limit conclusions.

Teach owns pacing and conversational synthesis. Preserve Why confidence, uncertainty, citations, competing hypotheses and evidence gaps through Unslop edits; editorial cleanup cannot upgrade evidence strength. Teach uses the same maintained Unslop catalog as Writing for Humans, bundled locally without invoking the broader writing workflow.

Use host-available read capabilities, roles, models and bounded delegation rather than fixed Cursor/provider defaults. Missing history, connectors or delegation are disclosed gaps; investigation remains read-only and never invents availability.

Architect is a selected design-first method, not a mandatory prelude to implementation. Respect design-only scope and opt-in checkpoints. Keep candidate stubs isolated, distinguish design validation from red/green behavior proof, and start selected TDD through the chosen agreed interface. Source-Driven supplies version-specific constraints. Existing verification and commit boundaries remain authoritative.

Architect requires two structurally distinct candidates before synthesis even if generic Arena allows dropout or convergence. Candidate runners execute only their isolated sketch assignment, never recursively launch the workflow. Shared grounding/review sources load directly without the Explain chooser. Host limitations and actual reviewer independence are disclosed; Interrogate is selected rather than automatic.

Required principles are contextual bundled references within authorized scope. Internal trust depends on established invariants; legitimate guards and enduring comments remain. Direct outcome proof uses the agreed artifact and commit policy rather than activating an unselected external Show Me Your Work audit. Global principle-library and public Arena adoption remain independent decisions.

Ordinary delegation and selection-only calls remain the default policy path. Arena owns candidate comparison/synthesis; Swarm owns partition/race/hybrid aggregation. Both use the shared selection reference directly without recursively selecting another workflow. Selected methods inherit the task write, evidence and delivery scope.

Preserve declared race/coverage semantics and exact revision/measurement evidence. Bounded waves or sequential fallback do not claim unavailable concurrency. Retry evidence omissions once, keep dropouts and unproved slices as gaps, verify winning artifacts and account for every worker and its cleanup.

Share the maintained Arena method and complete four-principle closure with Architect while preserving caller-specific minimums and proof criteria. Selection uses Team Up policy only; actual candidate/judge models and independence gaps are reported. No external audit workflow is activated.

Technical documentation uses the four writing layers within the existing author, reader and factual contracts. Section-level Diátaxis permits useful mixed READMEs/RFCs; evidence qualifications survive certainty rules; length rules are heuristics and code formatting follows the repository. Reuse the already loaded Unslop catalog without an additional mandatory pass. PR writing is removed from this package.

Unslop is the single editorial catalog shared by Writing for Humans, Explain and Tracking Audit Trail. Meaning, author voice and evidence qualifications outrank style patterns. Punctuation and domain terminology are contextual; preserve useful general guidance and requested narrative purposes. Each consumer carries the same patched bytes with stable rule IDs.

Audit Trail activates on explicit request or resume of a selected trail. Its append-only TSV is linked evidence attached to the single Tracking Home, not a second execution-state system. Show Me still owns presentation; Tracking retains commit, code-review, handoff and acceptance policy. Only selected Audit Trail adds an extra required tracking artifact.

Reconcile only the current run's stretches against its workspace-scoped transcript and evidence. Use a different-family read-only reviewer when available; report missing transcript access, independence or review as gaps without substituting self-review or unperformed No flags. Preserve append-only corrections and run ownership. Attention is recorded at checkpoint handoffs, not every progress reply; audit findings feed existing tracking state without a new acceptance gate.

Diagnose is the advisory default; Enforce requires explicit implementation authority and bounded recurring mistake classes. Corrections alone do not trigger edits. Preserve recurrence evidence, structural prevention and real-mistake proof without mandatory rule tables, unrelated repairs or automatic publication. Existing authorization needs no repeated approval.

Worst-case UI data enters the real component through an isolated temporary harness. Product source and live data stay unchanged; retaining fixtures and implementing fixes are separate authorized work. A recreation is not proof of the original component.

Mobile Web is a conditional reference, not a Craft mode. Existing methods own type, accessibility, layout, UI and motion. Platform fixes preserve selectable text, native activation and useful browser behavior; keyboard clearance requires browser-specific evidence rather than a dvh guarantee.

Interface explains observed mechanisms without a craft or accessibility verdict. Browser inspection stays read-only; a screenshot supports a qualified reconstruction, not proof of authored CSS, framework identity or accessibility conformance.

States is an explicitly requested workbench, not automatic setup for ordinary refinement or a review. Preserve the real component and its production styling; isolate fixture reads, refreshes and mutations and use separate inspection chrome. Setup hands over before visual edits; cleanup requires the user’s request.
